newsitem.title: USA: Enova, PET bid for Mexica natgas system.
newsitem.headline: Enova, PET bid for Mexica natgas system.

text.p: of Enova Corp and Pacific Enterprises, with their Mexican partner Proxima Gas, Thursday submitted a bid to the Mexican government to build and operate a natural gas system for the city of Chihuahua.
Chihuahua is a city of almost 630,000 in Northern Mexico with a strong automotive, ceramic and construction materials industrial base, the companies said.
The partners expect to serve at least 50,000 customers in the first five years of operation.
Bids for the project will be opened March 6 and the winning bidder will be announced March 20.

The partnership, which submitted the bid as Distribuidora de Gas Natural, was previously awarded a license to build and operate a natural gas infrastructure system for the border city of Mexicali, Baja California.
Enova International is a subsidiary of San Diego-based Enova Corp, which is also the parent of San Diego Gas & Electric Co.
Pacific Enterprises International is a subsidiary of Pacific Enterprises, a Los Angeles-based holding company whose principal subsidiary is Southern California Gas Co.
The two companies announced in October plans to merge, but regulatory approvals are still awaited.
